title: ATP Variable Dependency Graph
description: Adjacency structure representing dependencies between variables in an instance deployment. Used to determine load order and detect cycles.

load_order.description: Topologically sorted load position. Lower = load first. Nodes with no dependencies get order 0.

from.description: Dependent var — must be loaded AFTER 'to'

to.description: Dependency var — must be loaded BEFORE 'from'

type.description: requires=hard dependency, loading 'from' without 'to' is invalid. enriches=soft dependency, 'to' improves 'from' context but is not blocking.

cycles_detected.description: Any circular dependency chains detected. Must be empty for a valid graph.
